business.name: Never Blank
business.business_model: Service-led B2B content intelligence and production system
business.description: Never Blank turns current market signals and a configured business strategy into evidence-based, channel-specific content for founder-led service businesses. Release 1 uses controlled production for Wix and LinkedIn.

products_services.name: Continuous Content Presence
products_services.description: A controlled research, editorial, visual, validation, and publishing workflow that maintains a business's Wix and LinkedIn presence without requiring the owner to draft every publication manually.

products_services.name: Presence System Diagnostic
products_services.description: A structured examination of where a founder-led business's public presence depends on owner availability and where the production system breaks.

audiences.name: Founder-led digital, web, development, and creative agencies
problems: Client delivery displaces consistent market presence.
The work being delivered is more substantial than what prospective clients can see.
The agency becomes quiet while busy and has to restart visibility when the pipeline weakens.
audiences.default_problem: Client delivery displaces consistent market presence.
decision_factors: The system must preserve the agency's actual expertise and voice.
Claims must remain traceable to current evidence and real work.
The process must reduce owner drafting effort without publishing generic filler.
Wix and LinkedIn output must be independently useful and platform-appropriate.
objections: An automated system will sound generic or unlike the agency.
Maintaining the system may consume as much time as writing manually.
Content activity may not produce commercially meaningful conversations.

audiences.name: Independent consultants and advisors
problems: Expertise remains inside delivery work instead of becoming visible market evidence.
Publishing stops when client work becomes demanding.
Prospects cannot consistently encounter the consultant's current thinking between referrals.
audiences.default_problem: Expertise remains inside delivery work instead of becoming visible market evidence.
decision_factors: The content must protect nuance and avoid invented authority.
The system must distinguish evidence from interpretation.
The voice must remain direct, credible, and recognizably human.
The call to action must fit a trust-based advisory sale.
objections: A system cannot understand specialist judgment well enough to publish safely.
Frequent publishing may weaken rather than strengthen perceived expertise.
The consultant does not want aggressive sales language.

audiences.name: Founder-led managed service providers
problems: Operational delivery is visible to clients only when something fails or a project is active.
Technical competence is difficult for non-technical buyers to evaluate from the outside.
Market communication becomes sporadic because service continuity takes priority.
audiences.default_problem: Operational delivery is visible to clients only when something fails or a project is active.
decision_factors: Technical and commercial claims must be factually defensible.
The system must avoid exposing client, security, or operationally sensitive information.
Content must translate mechanisms into buyer-relevant consequences without oversimplifying.
Publication must be traceable and controllable.
objections: Content automation may create security or confidentiality risk.
Generic marketing language may damage technical credibility.
The team has limited capacity to review every publication.

positioning.statement: Never Blank is the content intelligence and production system for founder-led B2B service businesses whose market presence disappears when delivery work becomes busy.
expertise: Turning current signals and source evidence into business-relevant editorial decisions.
Separating business strategy, universal pipeline logic, and provider-specific publishing adapters.
Composing the same approved editorial decision independently for Wix and LinkedIn.
Preserving run identity, configuration identity, validation status, and publication results.
value_propositions: Maintain a credible content presence without making owner free time the production bottleneck.
Turn current evidence and real business expertise into content instead of filling a calendar with generic posts.
Preserve business voice, restrictions, and channel rules as explicit configuration rather than informal prompting.
Keep generated and published artifacts traceable to the run and strategy that produced them.
proof_points: The repository implements separate intake, research, editorial, validation, visual, Wix, and LinkedIn publishing boundaries that can be inspected and tested.
Controlled runs preserve unique run identity and immutable run-scoped generation and publication-result artifacts.
Never Blank maintains versioned strategy, brand voice, editorial methodology, and platform-rule artifacts in the repository.
Product or client outcome claims require verifiable publication records, run artifacts, analytics, or documented client evidence; the system must not infer outcomes from implementation alone.

priorities: Secure a first controlled pilot with a founder-led B2B service business.
Demonstrate the complete Wix and LinkedIn lifecycle using verifiable run evidence.
Use pilot evidence to decide which manual steps should be automated next.
Generate qualified conversations with agencies, consultants, and managed service providers that recognize owner-dependent presence.

objectives: Make the reader recognize a concrete presence pattern in their own business.
Explain the mechanism and commercial consequence behind that pattern.
Demonstrate Never Blank through quality of investigation and editorial judgment rather than direct product pitching.
Create a defensible path from recognition to reflection, diagnostic interest, example request, or direct conversation.
territories: Owner-dependent visibility and the periods when busy businesses disappear.
The gap between work performed and work visible to prospective clients.
Customer memory, accumulated recognition, trust, and continuity of presence.
The systems and decisions that allow market presence to continue during delivery work.
Evidence quality, editorial judgment, and the difference between useful content and generic output.

voice: Sharp: every sentence earns its place and the point arrives without a wind-up.
Observational: name what is happening before prescribing what should happen.
Direct and clean: avoid corporate language, inflated claims, and obscuring metaphors.
Commercially aware: connect the mechanism to recognition, pipeline, referrals, trust, or revenue timing when evidence supports that connection.
Reader-centered: the founder or owner is the central character; Never Blank is the observer.
editorial_principles: Use current source evidence and distinguish sourced facts from model interpretation.
Open with a concrete tension or observation, never a generic topic introduction or question.
Move from recognition through mechanism and business consequence to a genuine reframe.
Do not publish generic advice, motivational filler, or content whose main value is posting frequency.
Use an Echo only when it is specific to and earned by the article's argument.
When a CTA is configured, place it before the Echo and tie it to the specific pattern.
preferred_claims: Visibility can be treated as a business system rather than an owner personality trait.
Never Blank is designed to use current evidence and configured business meaning to produce distinct Wix and LinkedIn artifacts.
A controlled Never Blank run can preserve the identity and status of generated and publication-result artifacts.
Owner-dependent content production can create periods in which the market sees less of the work being performed.
prohibited_claims: Do not guarantee leads, revenue, reach, search ranking, engagement, or publication performance.
Do not claim that every business loses clients when it becomes quiet.
Do not claim personal observation of hundreds of businesses without a cited dataset.
Do not call a strategy, campaign, pilot, or product successful without recorded acceptance or outcome evidence.
Do not claim fully autonomous, error-free, or human-equivalent judgment.
Do not invent client results, testimonials, research volume, statistics, or causal conclusions.
legal_factual_reputational_restrictions: Every factual claim must be traceable to current evidence or explicitly identified as interpretation or hypothesis.
Do not expose credentials, private client information, security details, personal data, or confidential operational information.
Do not identify a client, partner, or individual as evidence without documented permission or an already-public attributable source.
Treat Presence Debt and other named concepts as hypotheses until recorded audience and commercial evidence supports stronger language.
Do not use AI or automation as a first-contact promise; describe implementation transparently when it becomes relevant.
A missing required source, restriction, approval, or configuration value blocks publication rather than triggering a generic fallback.

calls_to_action.intent: End on the earned editorial implication without a commercial invitation.
rules: Do not convert the Echo into a disguised sales invitation.

calls_to_action.intent: Invite the reader to recognize or examine the specific pattern in their own business.
rules: Keep the invitation soft and specific to the article.
Do not request a call, form submission, or purchase.
Reconnect to the Never Blank idea in the article's own language before inviting the reader onward.
Name https://www.inneros.online as the destination and no other URL.
Invite; never assert a capability. No 'we can help you…', no promised outcome, no implied diagnosis.

calls_to_action.intent: Invite the reader to show the current presence system and identify where it breaks.
rules: Do not promise an outcome or manufacture urgency.

calls_to_action.intent: Invite the reader to request a relevant example of the system or pattern.
rules: Name what example the reader can request.
Do not use generic learn-more language.

calls_to_action.intent: Invite a direct conversation about whether the observed pattern exists in the reader's business.
rules: Tie the invitation to evidence established by the article.
Do not use book-a-call, free-consultation, buy-now, or transformation language.

article_rules: Develop exactly ONE central idea and ONE primary mechanism or reframe. A signal that contains several interesting angles yields several future articles, never one article with several arguments.
Use 400–600 words. A shorter article that earns every sentence is correct; padding an argument to reach a length is not.
Never structure the article as a list of lessons, takeaways, or tips. Follow the arc: observation, tension, question, mechanism, evidence, reframe, one focused practical consequence, close.

Open with an H1 that creates a real reason to read — a tension, contradiction, surprising observation, or business consequence — without manufactured drama and without giving away the reframe. A title that merely names the subject is not a hook.
Use clear H2 structure and short paragraphs, and keep factual claims traceable so the article stays quotable without losing necessary context.

Attribute every external fact to the exact source recorded in the accepted evidence. Never credit the company or platform the case is about as the reporter of the result unless the accepted evidence is that party's own document.
State the evidence as a principle it supports, never as a proven result for the reader's own category, market, or channel.

Any description of what owners or buyers typically do, feel, or receive must be written as a hypothetical scenario addressed to the reader — 'if', 'you might', 'suppose' — never as reported market behaviour. Only the accepted evidence may be stated as fact.
metadata_rules: Provide a descriptive headline and slug that accurately represent the article.

Metadata is never body text. The article body must contain no 'Slug:', 'Tags:', 'Category:', 'Cover metadata:' or similar label lines — those travel in the publication package, not in the prose a reader sees.
Use relevant SEO/GEO language naturally; do not manufacture keyword repetition.
Supply required Wix category, tag, and cover metadata through the publication package.
link_rules: Preserve source attribution for factual claims.
Use internal links only when the destination is relevant and verified.
Do not publish empty, placeholder, malformed, or unverified links.
cta_rules: Follow the configured CTA mode exactly.
When present, express the CTA as a natural paragraph tied to the article and place it before the Echo.

Close by reconnecting the article's own mechanism to the Never Blank idea — that consistent presence is what turns attention into something a business can continue. Write it fresh for this article; never paste a standard slogan.
When CTA mode is none, do not add an invitation.
End the invitation with the canonical destination https://www.inneros.online and no other URL.
The invitation makes no claim about what Never Blank can do, achieve, diagnose, or help with. Invite the reader onward; do not describe a capability the evidence has not established.
visual_rules: Use the approved current-run Wix cover asset with verified identity, dimensions, and format.
Derive the visual anchor from the article's core idea, not generic entrepreneur or laptop imagery.
Missing or invalid required visual evidence blocks the Wix package.

opening_rules: The first line must state a concrete professional tension or observation before the see-more boundary.
Do not open with a question, preamble, corporate news item, or generic market statement.
Begin with recognition and then explain the mechanism and specific business implication.
length_rules: Use only the length required for one complete LinkedIn argument, and express the same single idea as the article — never a second argument and never a list of takeaways.
The artifact must be independently composed from the approved editorial decision, not truncated from the Wix article.
Follow hook, tension, mechanism or reframe, one concise implication, Never Blank close, website invitation.

Only the accepted evidence may be stated as fact, attributed to its recorded source. Everything about the reader's situation is a hypothetical scenario or the author's interpretation, and must read as one.
formatting_rules: Use short paragraphs and deliberate white space for feed reading.
Use three to five article-specific niche hashtags and no blacklisted generic hashtags.
Preserve the approved Echo verbatim when the article has one.
link_rules: Use the verified Wix article URL when the composition calls for a link.
Place source or article links according to the approved composition without placeholder URLs.
Do not report a generic LinkedIn feed URL as the created publication URL.
cta_rules: Follow the configured CTA mode exactly.
When present, use a paragraph-length invitation tied to the post and place it before the Echo.
Close by reconnecting to the Never Blank idea in this post's own terms, then invite the reader to continue at https://www.inneros.online.
When CTA mode is none, do not add an invitation.
The invitation makes no claim about what Never Blank can do or achieve for the reader.
visual_rules: Use the approved current-run LinkedIn asset or an explicitly validated link composition.
The LinkedIn visual may share a visual family with Wix but must satisfy LinkedIn dimensions and purpose.
Missing or invalid required visual evidence blocks the LinkedIn package.

editorial_roles.intent: A documented small-business, owner-led, or early-stage business story: verified facts, one observable mechanism, the Compound Presence lens applied with explicit bounds, one bounded reflection for an owner-led reader, and published sources. It does not need to be breaking news.
structure: Hook or business tension: open on a fact, contradiction, surprising consequence or tension. Never restate the source headline.
Verified account of what happened: only documented, verifiable facts, and only as much as the mechanism requires.
Why this case is worth examining: the non-obvious business significance.
The one observable mechanism: exactly ONE mechanism actually visible in the documented case — never a broader pattern the case does not show.
Compound Presence lens, explicitly bounded: what this mechanism suggests about consistent presence and being remembered, stated as an interpretation of this case, never as a proven law.
One practical question or consequence an owner-led reader can examine. One, not several.

Keep three things distinguishable throughout: documented facts, the observable mechanism, and the bounded Never Blank reflection. The reflection may say what is worth examining; it may never present this company's outcome as evidence of the reader's likely result.
Never Blank close: reconnect to the Never Blank idea in this article's own language.
Website invitation: the canonical configured destination.
Source attribution: name the published sources the facts came from.
Section headings are not required in the prose; the movement through the structure is what matters.
forbidden: '5 lessons from X', '3 takeaways', or any list of lessons.
Generic small-business advice that would fit any article.
More than one mechanism, or several unrelated mechanisms.
Background beyond what the mechanism needs.
A large-company outcome transferred, silently or openly, to smaller businesses.
An unsupported universal pattern or causal law derived from one case.
Citation used as a substitute for verification.
Forcing Compound Presence onto a story it does not fit.
eligibility_criteria: Eligible: a documented case genuinely about a small business, an owner-led business, a founder-led operating business at a meaningfully small or early stage, or an early-stage company.
A company that is large today is eligible ONLY when the documented episode occurred while it was still meaningfully small, founder-led, or early-stage.
Ineligible: current large-company or public-company/major-corporate behaviour, however recognizable the company or interesting the analogy.
Ineligible: any case whose connection to an owner-led/small-business audience exists only by analogy.
Ineligible: any case whose business scale, stage, or ownership the available material does not establish. Unknown is ineligible; never classify an unestablished company as small.
wix_rules: Materially verifiable external claims keep publishable provenance: the article carries a visible Sources section and/or appropriate inline source links naming where the facts came from.
Attribution never substitutes for verification, and no source or URL is ever invented.
linkedin_rules: Carry compact source attribution sufficient to identify the source case — one clear reference, not citation-heavy prose.
